test_random_search_smoke: test the random search functionality by running random_search with a make_env callback and verifying output files
run_random_search: run random_search with a make_env factory, output directory, patience, total_runtime, nproc, and skip_done parameters
replay_actions_from_logs: replay the best actions from random search logs into a fresh environment and generate progress and commandline files
create_llvm_autophase_env: create an llvm-autophase-ic-v0 gym environment with the cbench-v1/dijkstra benchmark set
set_command_line_flags: set command line flags for the test environment before running random search
